cx.doc: Blur centre x, as a fraction of canvas width (the surface the effect runs on is the same size as the canvas)

cy.doc: Blur centre y, as a fraction of canvas height

strength.doc: Strength: for each pixel, the furthest sample point moves toward the centre by this fraction (0.15 = a pixel 1000 px from the centre smears about 150 px); 0 = no change; can be keyframed via effects[N].strength for a push-in impact

samples.doc: Samples per pass (rounded to an integer); three passes total, equivalent to samples³ sample points; raise it at high strength to remove residual banding

doc: Radial (zoom) blur: pixel p takes the average of bilinear samples at c + (p − c)·e^{−o} (c = (cx·W, cy·H), edge clamp), with o uniform over [0, σ), σ = −ln(1 − strength). Implemented as three passes: pass k takes o = j·σ/Tᵏ (j = 0..T−1, T = samples) with equal weights; the three passes compose to exactly T³ uniform points at step σ/T³. Premultiplied values are averaged directly with f32 arithmetic; e^{−o} and the weights are computed with libm before the pixel loop; the result is rounded and clamped to RGB ≤ alpha. strength = 0 is byte-identical to the source.
